name: After The Debate
source:
After the presidential debate, Kamala Harris is tired and needs to unwind in the garden behind the venue. When Melania Trump, the former First Lady, appears, what happens next? A blooming romance occurs between the presidential candidate and former First Lady! 

[From [url=https://afterthedebate.itch.io/after-the-debate]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
总统辩论结束后，卡马拉·哈里斯感到很累，需要在会场后面的花园里放松一下。当前第一夫人梅拉尼娅·特朗普出现时，接下来会发生什么？总统候选人和前第一夫人之间发生了一场盛开的恋情！

[来自[url=https://afterthedebate.itch.io/after-the-debate]itch.io[/url]]
